description: Buy a home or keep renting? See which leaves you richer. Same calculation as https://paisafinder.com/calculators/rent-vs-buy-calculator. Every input is optional; anything left out uses the default shown in its schema.

appreciation.description: Home price growth (per year) (%). Indian homes: about 4-6% a year over the last decade

down.description: Down payment (%). Banks lend up to 75-90% of the price

invReturn.description: Return on invested money (%). What the renter earns on the down payment and the monthly savings

rent.description: Monthly rent for a similar home (rupees)

stamp.description: Stamp duty + registration (%). Paid once at purchase; 5-8% in most states

upkeep.description: Upkeep (per year, % of price). Maintenance, property tax, insurance, repairs; rises with rent

name: rent_vs_buy_calculator
title: Rent vs Buy
